context_of_use: one hashed AddBiomechanics Subject40 B3D sample; contract, source-consistency, reference and leakage validation only

split.calibration: no parameter fitting in contract-only test
split.evaluation: one untouched contiguous time window after metadata and coordinate conversion are frozen

baselines.description: parse source metadata and emit explicit UNKNOWN values without numerical inference

metrics.aggregation: maximum absolute error and exact metadata equality
maximum norm error after forward and inverse transform

acceptance.condition: all v0.2 documents validate against JSON Schema 2020-12 and the retained HumanModelSpec v0.1 schema
every coordinate space, processing pass, channel, adapter, target block and target frame reference resolves uniquely
each inconsistent source check points to a structured warning reviewed by the adapter
no input channel carries a forbidden leakage tag
unknown coordinate spaces, missing adapter_ref, mismatched cross-document refs, unreported source inconsistencies and unresolved mappings cannot produce a ready validation case

failure_behavior: fail closed on unresolved frame, coordinate-space or unit conversion
mark trial unusable for kinetics when MissingGRFReason indicates unreliable acceleration or torque
do not substitute dynamics-pass values for independent measurements
preserve source artifact and write a separate adapter error record
